description: Chief Secretariat - Southern Province - Imposition of Entertainment Tax - 2024 for Matara Pradeshiya Sabha, Weligama Pitabeddra and Welivitiya Divithura Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the imposition and regulation of entertainment tax by various Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) in the Southern Province. It references specific ordinances (Entertainment Tax Ordinance No. 12 of 1946, amended by various acts) and outlines regulatory requirements for tax collection. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it deals with the implementation and enforcement of tax regulations rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
